name_ja: 道後温泉 葛城 琴の庭
scope: ready lodging deep research reinforcement; not candidate collection

added_direct_sources.notes: Aside Browser opened Google Maps/Hotels review tab and long-scrolled Google-native author cards. This replaces the earlier Google 16/14 line rather than adding to it. Rating-only/no-body cards and Google provider cards were not counted.
All visible hotel review snippets/bodies on the 4travel hotel page were read. Signals include in-room source-flow bath, no in-house large bath, sister-facility baths, and room-bath size.
Three travelogues tied to the same 4travel lodging page were counted as direct long-form stay bodies, separate from 4travel hotel-review count.

Opened direct first-person or post-style stay bodies. Two note posts were added after web recheck: one states no large bath and describes the wide source-flow room onsen/water texture; the other describes room bath source-flow, moderate temperature, enough width, and repeated use. Later YouTube transcript bodies are counted separately from this blog/note/Lemon8 bucket.

Aside Browser showed Agoda-native 12 reviews plus an other-sites tab with 1. Counted only four visible Agoda-native body cards; one directly mentioned private room onsen. Other-site card and summary widgets were not counted. A later Aside recheck tried scrolling, sort modes, language filters, traveler-type filters, and keyword chips; the UI still rendered only the same four cards.

Food/meal review surface, not lodging OTA. Counted conservatively because individual author bodies tied to the exact property were readable and several mention 客室露天風呂, 半露天風呂, 源泉掛け流し, or cold-season room-bath usability.

Exact Kotononiwa stay videos were found. Counted only three transcripts where auto-generated Japanese text was readable enough for bath signals; noisy music/filler captions, description-only bath claims, and title-only/video-only evidence were excluded.

rechecked_not_counted_sources.notes: Current surface still shows 71 reviews; existing 2026-07-04 collection already counted 71 latest/archive bodies.

Aside Browser opened the combined review modal and loaded it to 91 direct body records with hasNextPage=false. The modal matches the already-counted Ikkyu 70 + Yahoo Travel 21 body pool, so no unique direct bodies were added. Yahoo Maps 4 visitor reviews remain separately counted in the Yahoo browser tags.
Trip.com page exposes Kotononiwa property text and says there are no posted reviews yet. Facility wording was not counted as review signal.

One Kotononiwa-labeled user review URL was readable and mentions source-flow onsen, but the page chrome/header points to Hotel Katsuragi Spa Resort Dogo. Kept as identity-mixed and not counted. The separate 110-review Hotel Katsuragi pool remains excluded.
Aside Browser/search did not surface an exact Kotononiwa Booking.com listing. Sibling Dogo-no-Yado Katsuragi results were excluded.
Korean pages expose property facts such as in-room mineral bath, but no individual guest body for this property. Kept as OTA facility fact only.
Korean query surfaces were ads, OTA/property pages, noisy hits, or one agency/recommendation-style Naver Blog page. No clean Korean firsthand stay body was counted.

updated_totals.why_not_A: Direct sample increased from 184 to 271 but remains 29 reviews short of 300. Google visible pool has 94 reviews, but Aside Browser recount exposed 55 body-bearing Google-native author cards; rating-only/no-body cards were excluded. Yahoo/Ikkyu combined modal was exhausted to 91 bodies but added 0 unique bodies because it matched already-counted Ikkyu/Yahoo pools. Agoda, Tabelog, YouTube transcripts, and two additional note stay bodies added usable low/medium-weight text, but Korean direct Naver Blog/Cafe stratum remains 0 and Booking exact target is not found.
